title: Neon Reaper in Graveyard
description: A black stylized grim reaper-like demon with a skull mask, pink energy wings, and flowing ribbons stands dynamically in a dark graveyard filled with broken tombstones and twisted vines. Above him floats a glowing pink angry sun with a face, enclosed within a large cracked spherical bubble, set against a dark sky with blue aurora-like streaks.
prompt: A stylized black grim reaper demon with skull mask, glowing pink energy wings and ribbons, standing in a spooky graveyard with broken tombstones and thorny vines. A large cracked spherical bubble contains a bright pink angry sun with a face and smaller orbs. Dark moody atmosphere with blue aurora streaks in the sky, high contrast digital art style with clean linework and vibrant neon accents.
